description:
[Protocol Health Oracle] All tracked protocols with their latest health score and verdict.

Use when you need every tracked protocol with its latest score and verdict. Not for one protocol's details (use protocol_health_score).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

min_tvl.description: Optional. Only protocols with TVL >= this USD amount.

name: protocol_health_list_protocols
